blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: General-purpose multimodal models have shown promise as direct robot action policies, yet whether they grasp the physics underlying real-world interactions and can apply that understanding to guide action remains underexplored. We investigate this question using contact-rich manipulation as a representative testbed, examining tactile understanding as a concrete instance of this broader capability. Contact-rich manipulation requires interpreting tactile feedback and adjusting actions after obstruction. Existing learned tactile policies acquire these capabilities through specialized pretraining and per-task optimization, with substantial data and training costs. We present GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, which summarizes expert demonstrations into task guidance and tactile references for contact assessment and corrective action. GPT-6-Astra combines this context with multimodal observations and interaction history to generate control commands and adjust actions through contact feedback. Without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning, our method achieves 93.8\% mean success across five UniVTAC tasks. Overall performance is comparable to state-of-the-art policies, with higher success on selected tasks. On Insert Hole, tactile feedback improves success from 31\% to 99\%. Execution analysis further demonstrates contact-guided probing and correction, supporting manipulation progress through explicit expert experience and online feedback.
blocks.zh: 通用多模式模式显示,作为直接的机器人行动政策,它们是否有希望,但它们是否掌握现实世界互动的基础物理学,能否运用这一理解来指导行动,仍然没有得到充分利用。 我们利用丰富的接触操纵作为具有代表性的试验台来调查这一问题,把触觉理解作为这一更广泛能力的具体实例。 接触力丰富的操纵需要解释触觉反馈,并在阻断后调整动作. 现有学习到的触觉政策通过专业的预训和每个任务优化获得这些能力,并需要大量的数据和培训费用。 我们提出全球反恐政策,其中总结了专家在任务指导和触觉参考方面的示范,以便进行联系评估和采取纠正行动。 GPT-6-Astra将这种上下文与多式联运观测和互动历史相结合,通过联系反馈生成控制命令并调整动作. 我们的方法实现了93.8 ========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================== 总体表现与最先进的政策相当,在选定任务上取得较高成功. 在插入洞时,触觉反馈会提高成功率,从31\%到99\%. 执行分析还表明,通过联系指导进行检测和纠正,通过明确的专家经验和在线反馈支持操纵进展。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The role of general-purpose large models in robotics is expanding
from task planning and skill selection ( Brohan et al., 2023 ) and control program generation ( Liang et al., 2023 ) to direct action decisions. Recent evaluations of GPT-6-Astra
show that a general-purpose multimodal model can generate
numerical robot actions from observations, task instructions,
and execution history, using feedback to determine subsequent
behavior ( Team et al., 2026a ) .
These studies progressively connect general knowledge to robot action,
raising a fundamental question: do general-purpose multimodal models
grasp the physics underlying real-world interactions, and can they
apply that understanding to guide their actions? Exploring this
question requires examining how models reason the physical
consequences of their actions and use interaction feedback to adjust
subsequent behavior ( Huang et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) .

blocks.en: Tactile understanding provides a representative test case for a model’s grasp of physics, because interpreting tactile feedback involves making sense of physical phenomena such as contact, deformation, and constrained motion. We therefore choose contact-rich tasks such as insertion and alignment as our experimental setting ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Bi et al., 2026 ) . Even after identifying a target and reaching the contact location, a robot can be obstructed by local pose errors and hidden geometric constraints ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Xue et al., 2025 ) . External vision provides scene layout and visible object motion, but offers limited access to deformation and motion constraints at the contact interface ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Higuera et al., 2026 ) . In this setting, tactile feedback allows us to examine whether models can connect the observed physical effects to their own actions and use that understanding to guide subsequent control.
blocks.zh: Tactile 理解为模型掌握物理提供了具有代表性的试验案例,因为解释触觉反馈涉及了解接触、变形和受约束的运动等物理现象。 因此,我们选择接触丰富的任务,如插入和配合作为我们的实验环境(黄等人,2025年;Bi等人,2026年)。 即使确定了目标并到达了联系地点,机器人也可能因局部的姿势错误和隐藏的几何限制而受阻(Huang等人,2024年;Xue等人,2025年)。 外部视觉提供场景布局和可见物体运动,但在接触界面上提供有限的变形和运动约束(Chen等人,2026年;Higuera等人,2026年). 在这种环境下,触觉反馈使我们能够检查模型是否能够将观察到的物理效应与自己的动作联系起来,并利用这种理解来指导后续的控制.

blocks.en:
Existing research has developed learned policies that integrate
touch into contact-rich manipulation. Representative approaches
include ACT with the UniVTAC encoder ( Chen et al., 2026 ) ,
the tactile-predictive 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA ( Team et al., 2026c ) , and the tactile-native world-action model 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -TWAM ( Team et al., 2026b ) . These approaches
acquire contact representations and manipulation capabilities
through representation learning, pretraining, and downstream
policy optimization. Their use of expert experience therefore
involves training dedicated representations or updating policy
parameters for downstream tasks. This motivates exploring an
alternative: making expert manipulation experience directly
available to a general-purpose model as task guidance,
without an additional task-specific policy training stage.

blocks.en:
To investigate this question without additional specialized pretraining
or per-task policy fine-tuning, we introduce GPT-as-Tactile-Policy,
which summarizes expert manipulation experience into task guidance
that a general-purpose model can use directly. As shown in Fig. 1 A, the model
combines this experience with current visual and tactile observations
and interaction history to directly generate robot actions, revising
subsequent attempts based on contact changes. Expert experience provides
principles for probing and correction, while real-time tactile feedback
helps the model determine how to apply them to the current interaction.
This process requires no policy parameter updates;

requirements with those of existing methods.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 B and Fig. 2 illustrate how tactile feedback changes the policy’s response to obstruction. Without tactile feedback, the policy repeatedly presses downward, retracts, and retries, but its orientation and lateral adjustments remain limited, leaving insertion incomplete. With tactile feedback, the policy actively explores alternative insertion directions and progressively adjusts the tube orientation and lateral position until insertion succeeds. This contrast illustrates how tactile feedback helps identify ineffective attempts, guide local correction, and restore manipulation progress. Across five contact-rich UniVTAC tasks, our method achieves overall performance comparable to extensively pretrained state-of-the-art methods and higher success rates on selected tasks, without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning, as shown in Fig. 1 C. Our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 图1B和图2说明了如何触觉反馈改变了政策对阻碍的反应。 没有触觉反馈,政策反复向下压,收回,重复,但其方向和横向调整仍然有限,使得插入不完整. 通过触觉反馈,政策积极探索替代插入方向,并逐步调整管向和横向位置,直至插入成功. 这种对比说明触觉反馈如何帮助识别无效的尝试,指导局部校正,恢复操纵进度. 在5项接触丰富的UniVTAC任务中,我们的方法实现的总体性能可以与经过广泛培训的先进方法和选定任务的较高成功率相媲美,而无需额外的机器人专用预训或每任务政策微调,如Fig所示. 1. C. 我们的主要贡献是:

and make progress after obstruction. • Experience-guided tactile reasoning. We summarize expert manipulation experience into fixed task guidance

with representative tactile references, this guidance helps the model
apply prior experience to current interactions. • SOTA-level performance without policy fine-tuning. Across five UniVTAC tasks, evaluated over 100 seeds per task

performance comparable to extensively pretrained state-of-the-art
methods and higher success rates on selected tasks, without additional
robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning.
Execution analyses further demonstrate how the model uses tactile
feedback to select probing directions, correct its pose, and make
progress after obstruction.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Language Models as Robot Policies
blocks.zh: 2.1 作为机器人政策的语言模式

blocks.en:
Language models have been used to translate pretrained task knowledge
into robot behavior through skill selection, program generation, and
motion planning. SayCan Brohan et al. (2023) combines language-model
estimates of task relevance with value-function estimates of skill
feasibility to select skill sequences for long-horizon manipulation.
Code as Policies Liang et al. (2023) generates policy
programs that process perception outputs and parameterize control
primitives, using program logic to express motion parameters,
conditional behavior, and feedback loops.
Instruct2Act Huang et al. (2023a) maps multimodal instructions
to Python policy programs that invoke perception, planning, and
action interfaces.
RoboScript Chen et al. (2024) emphasizes the deployability of
generated programs by integrating perception, motion planning, and
control through a unified interface for simulation and real robots.
VoxPoser Huang et al. (2023b) grounds language-inferred affordances
and constraints in visual observations through composable 3D value
maps, which support closed-loop trajectory generation through
model-based planning.
These approaches connect language-model knowledge to robot execution
through different intermediate representations.

model to explain failures, and provides these explanations to a
language-based planner for corrective planning.
These studies incorporate the consequences of previous actions
into subsequent decisions.

blocks.en: 2.2 Visuo-Tactile Manipulation Policies
blocks.zh: 2.2 Visuo-Tactile操纵政策

blocks.en:
Visuo-tactile manipulation combines scene observations with local
contact feedback to support fine-grained perception and control.
VITaL Pretraining George et al. (2025) investigates visuo-tactile
pretraining for imitation learning, showing benefits for both
policies that use touch during execution and policies deployed
without tactile input.
3D-ViTac Huang et al. (2024) integrates visual and tactile
observations into a unified 3D representation that preserves their
spatial structure and relationships, and combines this representation
with diffusion policies for fine-grained manipulation.
Reactive Diffusion Policy Xue et al. (2025) introduces
a slow-fast hierarchy that combines latent action-chunk generation
with high-frequency tactile feedback control, allowing the policy
to respond to contact changes during chunk execution.
These studies investigate how tactile information supports skill
learning and execution through representation learning and
feedback-aware control architectures.

blocks.en:
Recent work further integrates tactile sensing with the task
knowledge of vision-language-action (VLA) models.
VLA-Touch Bi et al. (2026) keeps the base VLA fixed while using
a pretrained tactile-language model to provide semantic feedback
for high-level planning and a diffusion-based controller to refine
actions using tactile signals.
Tactile-VLA Huang et al. (2025) combines tactile sensing with
hybrid position-force control to connect vision-language knowledge
to physical interaction; its CoT variant further explores
tactile-feedback-driven failure analysis and strategy adaptation.
OmniVTLA Cheng et al. (2026) addresses heterogeneous tactile
inputs through a dual-path tactile encoder and semantically
aligned representations. N 0 N_{0} -VTLA Team et al. (2026c) further explores large-scale
visuo-tactile pretraining, a predictive latent tactile pathway,
and offline policy improvement from stored deployment data.
Together, these approaches incorporate touch into semantic
understanding, policy adaptation, and action generation at
different decision levels.

blocks.en:
Our work studies a complementary setting in which a
general-purpose multimodal model serves as a direct action
policy with its parameters fixed.
Task knowledge is supplied through in-context guidance, and
the model combines this guidance with visual–tactile

Our focus is on how the model interprets contact feedback and
uses it to make online action decisions, complementing research
on learned visuo-tactile representations, control architectures,
and predictive models.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 GPT-as-Tactile-Policy
blocks.zh: 3.1 GPT-as-Tactile-政策

blocks.en: GPT-as-Policy uses a general-purpose multimodal model as a closed-loop robot action policy, selecting actions from the task instruction, observations, and interaction history ( Team et al., 2026a ) . In its direct-control formulation, GPT generates numerical end-effector and gripper targets, which a generic inverse-kinematics controller converts into robot motion; new observations after execution return to the model. The model therefore selects the next operation using available observations and feedback from preceding actions.
blocks.zh: GPT-as-Policy使用通用多模式模式作为闭路机器人行动政策,从任务指令,观察,互动历史中选择动作(Team等人,2026a). 在其直接控制配制中,GPT生成数字终端效应和抓取目标,一个通用的反光学控制器转换为机器人运动;执行后新的观测返回模型. 因此,该模型利用已有的观测结果和以往行动的反馈来选择下一个操作.

blocks.en: For contact-rich manipulation, we incorporate bilateral tactile feedback and task guidance summarized from expert demonstrations into this decision process. As shown in Fig. 1 A, the framework comprises offline experience summarization and online feedback control. Offline, GPT-6-Astra jointly analyzes expert actions, contact changes, and task progress to construct fixed context 𝒞 τ \mathcal{C}_{\tau} for task τ \tau . Online, the same model serves as the sole action policy, combining task guidance, visuo-tactile observations, and robot proprioception to interpret current contact responses and select actions. The resulting policy uses both fixed task experience and observations and history that evolve throughout the current interaction.
blocks.zh: 为了进行大量接触的操纵,我们将双边触觉反馈和从专家示范中总结的任务指南纳入这一决策进程。 如法智所显. 1 A, 框架包括离线经验汇总和在线反馈控制。 离线, GPT-6- Astra 联合分析专家动作, 联系方式变化, 并任务进度为任务\ tau 构造固定上下文 C \ mathcal{ C\ tau} 。 在线上,同一模式充当唯一的行动政策,结合任务指导、相对活性观测和机器人自主来解释当前的接触反应和选择行动。 由此产生的政策既利用固定的任务经验,也利用贯穿目前互动的观察和历史。

blocks.en: We formulate this policy as conditional action generation. At step t t , the observation is denoted by o t = ( V t , s t , 𝒯 t ) o_{t}=(V_{t},s_{t},\mathcal{T}_{t}) , where V t V_{t} contains scene and wrist-camera images, s t s_{t} denotes the robot’s proprioceptive state, and 𝒯 t \mathcal{T}_{t} comprises tactile observations from fingertips. Given a natural-language task instruction ℓ \ell , the policy generates an action as a t ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ ℓ , 𝒞 τ , o t , ℋ t ) , a_{t}\sim\pi_{\theta}\!\left(\cdot\mid\ell,\mathcal{C}_{\tau},o_{t},\mathcal{H}_{t}\right), (1) where 𝒞 τ \mathcal{C}_{\tau} denotes the fixed task context comprising a textual Task Skill and reference tactile observations, ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} records preceding observations, actions, and execution feedback within the episode, and a t a_{t} specifies the target end-effector pose, gripper position, and a short execution horizon. After each execution, new observations enter the interaction history and provide feedback for subsequent actions. Model parameters θ \theta remain fixed throughout offline experience summarization and online execution.

blocks.en: 3.2 Task Knowledge Construction from Expert Demonstrations
blocks.zh: 3.2 任务知识 专家示范建筑

blocks.en: To provide task guidance for the online policy in Section 3.1 , we construct fixed task context from expert demonstrations before execution. These demonstrations contain sequential visual and tactile observations, robot states, and expert actions, recording changes in contact and task progress during manipulation. As shown in Fig. 1 A, GPT-6-Astra jointly analyzes these sequences, relating contact changes and object motion before and after actions to summarize how experts assess progress, select adjustments, and evaluate their effects. The resulting guidance forms the textual Task Skill K τ K_{\tau} .
blocks.zh: 为了在第3.1节中为在线政策提供任务指导,我们从专家演示中构建了固定的任务背景。 这些演示包含相继的视觉和触觉观测,机器人状态,以及专家行动,记录接触的变化以及操纵过程中的任务进展. 如图1A所示,GPT-6-Astra联合分析这些序列,在行动前后联系变化和物体运动,总结专家如何评估进展,选择调整和评价其影响。 由此产生的指南构成文字任务技能 K \\ K\ tu} 。

blocks.en: The Task Skill organizes this experience into task objectives, manipulation principles, evidence for stage transitions, and corrective strategies for obstructions. It specifies which observations to examine and how they should inform subsequent actions. For example, increasing deformation without object advancement during insertion prompts retraction to relieve contact, followed by a positional or angular adjustment evaluated through subsequent feedback. This knowledge gives tactile changes operational meaning, helping the model determine when to advance, when to adjust, and which feedback to examine when assessing an adjustment.
blocks.zh: " 任务技能 " 将这种经验组织成任务目标、操纵原则、阶段过渡的证据和障碍的纠正战略。 它具体规定了审查哪些意见以及如何为以后的行动提供信息。 例如,插入时增加变形而无对象进化,会促使收回以解除接触,然后通过后续反馈来评价位置或角调整. 这种知识赋予触觉改变操作意义,帮助模型确定何时推进,何时调整,以及评估某项调整时检查哪些反馈.

blocks.en: GPT-6-Astra also extracts representative tactile observations from expert demonstrations to form the reference set ℰ τ tac \mathcal{E}_{\tau}^{\mathrm{tac}} , preserving bilateral contact distributions and local deformation patterns. The Task Skill provides principles for contact assessment and manipulation adjustment, while tactile references provide perceptual grounding for these principles. We organize both components into the task context 𝒞 τ = ( K τ , ℰ τ tac ) , \mathcal{C}_{\tau}=\left(K_{\tau},\mathcal{E}_{\tau}^{\mathrm{tac}}\right), (2) which serves as a fixed conditioning input to the GPT policy defined in Section 3.1 . At each decision step, the model combines this context with current observations and interaction history to assess whether tactile changes accompany manipulation progress and to select continued advancement, probing, or corrective actions. New observations after execution reveal the effects of the selected action and inform the next decision.
blocks.zh: GPT-6-Astra也从专家演示中提取具有代表性的触觉观测结果,形成参考集E\ tac\ mathcal{E}_{\tau}^{\mathrm{tac}}},保留双边接触分布和当地变形模式. " 任务技能 " 为联系评估和操纵调整提供了原则,而触觉参考则为这些原则提供了概念基础。 我们把这两个部分组织到任务上下文C\\(K\,E\ tac),\ mathcal{C}_{\tau\左(K_{\tau},\mathcal{E}_{\tau}^{\mathrm{tac}}\right),(2),作为第3.1节定义的GPT政策的固定条件投入。 在每一个决策步骤,模型将这一背景与当前观察和互动历史相结合,以评估操纵进展是否伴随着触觉变化,并选择继续推进、探测或纠正行动。 执行后的新观察显示选定行动的效果,并告知下一项决定。

blocks.en: 3.3 Online Visuo-Tactile Observation Representation
blocks.zh: 3.3 在线Visuo-Tactile观测代表

blocks.en: During online execution, we provide both bilateral tactile images and structured tactile descriptions to preserve local contact details and support comparison of contact distributions and deformation changes. Following Section 3.1 , we expand 𝒯 t \mathcal{T}_{t} as 𝒯 t = { ( I t f , D t f , M t f ) } f ∈ { L , R } , \mathcal{T}_{t}=\left\{\left(I_{t}^{f},D_{t}^{f},M_{t}^{f}\right)\right\}_{f\in\{L,R\}}, (3) where f ∈ { L , R } f\in\{L,R\} indexes the left and right fingertips, respectively, and I t f I_{t}^{f} denotes the tactile image. The descriptors D t f D_{t}^{f} summarize the spatial distribution and statistics of indentation depth, while M t f M_{t}^{f} records two-dimensional marker displacements relative to reference positions.
blocks.zh: 在在线执行期间,我们既提供双边触觉图像,也提供结构化触觉描述,以保存局部联系细节,并支持联系分布和变形变化的比较. 第3.1节之后,我们将 T t\ mathcal{T}_{t} 扩展为 T { (I t f, D t f, M t f) } { { L, R},\ mathcal{ 左\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左_{左_{左_{左_{右_{右}^{右}^{右}^{右\}_{右\{右\{右\{右\{右\{左\{右\{右\{右\{右\{左\{\右\{右\{右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\{右\{右\{右\{右\{右\{\右\{右\}}右\{\右\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左\{\左}左}左}左}左}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右}\右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右\}}右 (3) f  {L, R} f\in\{L, R\} 分别索引左指和右指, It f I_{t}^{f} 表示触觉图像. 描述符 D t f D_{t}^{f} 总结缩进深度的空间分布和统计,而 M t f M_{t}^{f} 记录了相对于参考位置的二维标记移位.

blocks.en: For spatial contact distributions, we spatially pool gel indentation maps and provide statistical descriptions, including mean indentation, peak indentation, contact regions, and centroids, characterizing contact location, extent, and indentation distribution. Marker displacements further describe local deformation directions and spatial patterns within contact regions. Information from the two fingertips is retained separately, allowing the model to compare bilateral contact differences and their evolution.
blocks.zh: 对于空间接触分布,我们空间集合凝胶缩合图并提供统计描述,包括平均缩合,峰值缩合,接触区,和中间行星,描述接触位置,范围,缩合分布. 标记移位进一步描述了接触区域内的局部变形方向和空间规律. 两个指尖的信息被单独保留,使模型能够比较双边接触差异及其演变.

blocks.en: To relate contact changes to executed actions, the model considers indentation distributions and marker displacements across successive observations together with the measured end-effector and gripper motion over the same interval. Visual observations further reveal object motion relative to the target and gripper, connecting actual robot motion, object response, and tactile changes. Updated through execution, these observations provide current contact evidence for applying the Task Skill and feedback for subsequent closed-loop action generation.
blocks.zh: 为了将接触变化与已执行的行动联系起来,该模型考虑连续观测的缩进分布和标记移位,以及在同一间隔内测量的终端效应器和抓取器运动。 视觉观察进一步揭示了物体运动相对于目标与捕捉者,连接实际的机器人运动,物体反应,以及触觉变化. 这些观察通过执行更新,为应用任务技能提供了当前联系证据,并为随后的闭路动作生成提供了反馈.

blocks.en: 3.4 Closed-Loop Action Generation from Interaction Feedback
blocks.zh: 3.4 互动反馈产生的闭环行动

blocks.en: During online execution, the decision policy π θ \pi_{\theta} assesses manipulation progress using the current observation o t o_{t} and interaction history ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} . It constructs action a t a_{t} from the latest measured robot state. After checks on command bounds and format, a generic inverse-kinematics controller executes the target for one to five control steps. A new observation o t + 1 o_{t+1} is then acquired. Short execution horizons allow prompt contact assessment and adjustment of subsequent motion.
blocks.zh: 在在线执行期间,决定政策 \\\\\\theta} 使用当前观察 o t\\\\\\\\} 和交互历史 H t\ mathcal{H\\\} 来评估操纵进度 。 它从最新测量的机器人状态中构造一个动作 t a_{t}. 在检查命令界限和格式后,一个通用的反光学控制器执行目标1至5个控制步骤. 然后获得一个新的观察o t + 1 o_{t+1}. 执行范围短,可以对随后的动议进行及时的接触评估和调整。

blocks.en: After each execution, the decision policy π θ \pi_{\theta} compares o t o_{t} and o t + 1 o_{t+1} to assess the effects of action a t a_{t} . It jointly examines end-effector motion, object responses, and tactile changes to determine whether manipulation has progressed. Guided by Task Skill K τ K_{\tau} , the policy determines whether alignment or grasp adjustments are needed. It then generates the next action a t + 1 a_{t+1} .
blocks.zh: 每次执行后,决定政策====================================== 它联合审查终极效应运动、物体反应和触觉变化,以确定操纵是否取得进展。 政策在“任务技能K \\\\\ t” 的指导下,决定是否需要调整或把握调整。 然后生成下一个动作 a t + 1 a_{t+1}.

blocks.en: When observations leave the adjustment direction uncertain, the decision policy π θ \pi_{\theta} actively explores to acquire additional contact information. Exploratory actions include small translations, orientation adjustments, and changes in gripper opening. The policy assesses contact changes and task progress using object motion and bilateral tactile feedback. This feedback guides the direction and magnitude of subsequent actions. Exploratory actions and their observed outcomes are incorporated into the interaction history ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} . Subsequent decisions therefore build on accumulated interaction evidence to progressively refine manipulation.
blocks.zh: 当观察结果导致调整方向不确定时,决定政策将积极探索获取更多的联系信息。 探索行动包括小译,方向调整,以及抓取开口的变化. 该政策利用物体运动和双边触觉反馈来评估联系变化和任务进度. 这一反馈指导了随后行动的方向和规模。 探索行动及其观测结果被纳入互动历史 H t \ mathcal{ {\fn华文仿宋\fs16\1cHD1D1D1}哈,哈 因此,随后的决定以累积的互动证据为基础,逐步完善操纵。

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We compare our method with visual, visuo-tactile, and world-action
baselines on five UniVTAC tasks and conduct a tactile ablation
on Insert Hole.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on five contact-rich manipulation tasks from UniVTAC ( Chen et al., 2026 ) : Insert Hole , Lift Can , Grasp Classify , Lift Bottle , and Pull-out Key . These tasks cover geometric alignment, grasped-object manipulation, constrained motion, and tactile classification.
blocks.zh: 我们评价UniVTAC(Chen等人,2026年)的五项富于接触的操纵任务: 插入洞,升空罐,Grasp分类,升空瓶,和拉出键。 这些任务包括几何对齐,抓取对象操纵,受限运动,以及触觉分类.

blocks.en:
For each task, we use 50 expert demonstrations, split at the episode
level into 40 for knowledge construction and 10 for offline validation.
From the construction subset, GPT-6-Astra analyzes contact changes and
object motion before and after expert actions to distill the Task Skill
for progress assessment and manipulation adjustment. It also extracts tactile references
preserving bilateral contact distributions and local deformation
patterns. Together, these components form the task context, which is
fixed before formal evaluation and used across all test episodes
of the same task.
blocks.zh:
每个任务,我们用50个专家演示, 在剧集中分开
分为40级用于知识建设,10级用于离线验证.
从构造子集中,GPT-6-Astra分析接触变化和
专家动作前后的天体运动以提炼任务技能
用于进度评估和操纵调整。 还可以提取触觉参考
保持双边联系分布和当地变形
规律 这些组成部分共同构成任务背景,即:
正式评价前固定并用于所有测试阶段
任务。

blocks.en: We compare against four methods previously evaluated on UniVTAC. E0 ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} provide a vision-only baseline to assess manipulation under contact constraints ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ) . ACT + UniVTAC Encoder uses pretrained visuo-tactile representations ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA is a state-of-the-art policy with latent tactile prediction ( Team et al., 2026c ) . 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -TWAM jointly models future vision, touch, and actions ( Team et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了先前在UniVTAC上评价的四种方法. E0 (Zhan等人, 2026年)和 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}提供了一个仅用于评估在接触限制下操纵的愿景基线(Intelligence等人, 2025年). ACT + 单维TAC 编码器使用预先训练的粘合-活性表示(Chen等人,2026年)。 N 0\ mathcal{ N}_{0} (韩语) - VTLA是一项具有潜在触觉预测的先进政策(Team等人,2026c)。 N 0\ mathcal{ N}_{0} (韩语) - TWAM联合模拟未来愿景、触摸和行动(Team等人,2026年b)。

blocks.en: We use GPT-6-Astra as the decision policy π θ \pi_{\theta} , with reasoning effort fixed to xhigh . The same model and reasoning configuration is used across all tasks. Each test episode starts an independent model session, with interaction history ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} updated within the episode and reset between episodes. Observations and action execution follow Sections 3.3 and 3.4 , respectively.

blocks.en: Tab. 2 compares GPT-as-Policy with ACT + UniVTAC Encoder, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA, and 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -TWAM on five UniVTAC tasks. Our GPT-as-Policy achieves competitive performance without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning. Its mean success rate of 93.8% approaches the 96.2% achieved by 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA and exceeds the 84.6% of 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -TWAM. Viewed alongside the training requirements in Tab. 1 , these results highlight a different route to task adaptation: expert demonstrations are organized into task guidance that a general-purpose model can apply during online control.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation on Tactile Information

blocks.en: We evaluate the role of tactile feedback in corrective actions and reliable insertion on Insert Hole. We compare the full policy Ours with a tactile-free variant w/o tactile . The variant retains vision, proprioception, and the action interface, while removing tactile information and tactile references. Each configuration uses a fixed Task Skill matched to its available observations. Both are evaluated on the same 100 test configurations with identical initialization, low-level controllers, and execution budgets. Model and session settings follow Section 4.1 .

blocks.en: To illustrate how tactile feedback affects adjustments after obstruction, we visualize representative insertion episodes with and without touch in Fig. 2 . Without touch, repeated attempts produce limited changes in tube orientation and lateral end-effector position. Insertion remains incomplete at step 300. With touch, the policy actively explores alternative insertion directions and progressively adjusts the tube orientation and lateral position. It completes insertion at step 191. The angle and displacement traces record these adjustments relative to each episode’s initial state. The tactile-enabled policy revises its local approach, illustrating how contact feedback supports exploration of alternative insertion directions and restores manipulation progress.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
To enable general-purpose multimodal models to use contact feedback for action adjustment, we present GPT-as-Tactile-Policy,
which combines expert-derived task guidance with online tactile observations. Expert experience provides task guidance for contact assessment and manipulation adjustment.
Online tactile feedback provides evidence for evaluating action outcomes and selecting subsequent adjustments.
Without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning, our method achieves overall performance comparable to state-of-the-art policies across five UniVTAC tasks, matching or exceeding the compared methods on selected tasks.
Tactile ablation and execution analysis further demonstrate the role of contact feedback in local probing, directional adjustment, and restoring progress after obstruction. These results establish explicit task knowledge combined with online interaction feedback as an effective route to efficient contact-rich manipulation.
blocks.zh:
为了使通用的多式联运模式能够利用联系反馈进行行动调整,我们提出全球统一处理法(GPT-as-Tactile-Policy),
将专家提出的任务指南与在线触觉观测结合起来。 专家经验为联系评估和操纵调整提供了任务指导。
在线触觉反馈为评估行动结果和选择后续调整提供了证据。
没有额外的机器人专用预训或每任务政策微调,我们的方法在5个UniVTAC任务中实现总体性能与最先进的政策相当,匹配或超过选定任务的比较方法.
Tactile衰减和执行分析进一步证明了联系反馈在局部探险,方向调整以及阻断后恢复进展中的作用. 这些成果确立了明确的任务知识,与在线互动反馈相结合,成为高效的多接触操纵的有效途径。
